page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is a storage-oriented virtual machine belonging to the Local SSDs instance family. Built on the KVM hypervisor using x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It provisions 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores via hyper-threading, accompanied by 64 GB of RAM, adhering to a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512F, AES, and FMA, backed by a 33 MB L3 cache.

A key component of the hardware configuration is the integrated 1919 GB local SSD storage alongside a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Synthetic testing reveals a marked divergence between single-threaded and parallel processing. Single-core metrics in stress-ng (1108.09) and Geekbench (937.0) place the server in lower historical quartiles, matching reduced throughput in single-threaded compression benchmarks. In contrast, multi-core execution shows balanced performance, achieving 11753.77 in stress-ng multi-core, 5851.0 in Geekbench multi-core, and 12919.13 in PassMark CPU testing. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 72.03 GB/sec, supporting 11.71 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations.

The qualitative tradeoff of the ecs.i2gne.4xlarge centers on local resource density versus per-core processing power. While the Intel Skylake generation CPU delivers lower per-thread compute relative to newer platforms, the bundled 1.9 TB of local solid-state storage eliminates reliance on external block devices for write-heavy throughput. This configuration fits disk-bound operations, including transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, Redis caching clusters, search indices, and log collection pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is a local-storage optimized virtual machine configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 8 physical cores, powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Operating on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it provides 64 GB of RAM, a 5 Gbps network interface, and 1919 GB of integrated local SSD storage without dedicated GPUs. Multi-core benchmarks achieve standard middle-tier performance, highlighted by a PassMark CPU score of 12919.13 and 11.71 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-core compute ranks in lower performance brackets. The integrated high-capacity SSD delivers local I/O density without external storage latency. This instance profile is engineered for operational database hosting, distributed caching nodes, log aggregation, and transactional systems requiring dedicated disk storage alongside balanced memory capacity.
